title: Minimum Elements to Add to Form a Given Sum
summary: Given an integer array nums with elements whose absolute values do not exceed a limit, determine the least number of elements to add to make the array sum equal to a specified goal, while ensuring all new elements also meet the limit.
statement: Given an integer array nums with elements whose absolute values do not exceed a limit, determine the least number of elements to add to make the array sum equal to a specified goal, while ensuring all new elements also meet the limit.
constraints: Every existing and added value must have absolute value at most limit.
Return the minimum number of added elements needed to make the total equal goal.
hints: Each added number can close at most limit units of the sum gap.
Compute the absolute difference between the current sum and goal.
Divide the gap by limit and round upward.
No single addition can contribute more than limit toward the gap, while full-limit values plus one remainder always achieve the ceiling.
editorial: No single addition can contribute more than limit toward the gap, while full-limit values plus one remainder always achieve the ceiling.
